description: Renames a class type or changes its default spots, colour, whether packs are charged or whether it is drop-in. Spots apply to classes created from now on. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

drop_in.description: True = no times on the timetable: people just come in and check in (e.g. the gym floor). Each check-in takes one class from their pack, at most once a day.

name: update_class_type
title: Change a class type
